answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The island holds work receipts rather than names, so the zenith of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the echo of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
